Key columns of an OMOP table

Source: R/omop-metadata.R
omop_table_all_key_columns.Rd

The primary key column of table together with its non-vocabulary foreign key columns. Foreign keys into the vocabulary concept table are excluded, so *_concept_id columns are not returned.

Usage

omop_table_all_key_columns(table)

Arguments

table

OMOP table name

Value

A character vector of column names.

Details

These are the columns that identify a row and its relationships rather than describing it, and they are the columns dropped by omop_es_tbl_with_links() when drop_omop_foreign_keys = TRUE. Dropping them is useful when diffing two extracts, because surrogate keys are not expected to be stable between pipeline runs.

See also

omop_source_tables_for_foreign_key_columns() for the corresponding table names.
